findings.evidence: Line 8 imports `CauchyPrincipalValueOn`, while `rg` in this file finds only `CauchyPVExistsAt`/`cauchyPVExistsAt_of_avoidance` uses at lines 52, 61, 68, and 85, all available through `NullHomologous -> WindingNumber -> CauchyPrincipalValue`.
findings.fix: Drop this import, or make it a non-public import only if some implementation detail needs it; `NullHomologous` already brings in the single-point CPV API used by the declarations here.

summary: The reversal declarations themselves have the expected characteristic API, but the new winding-number module publicly re-exports unrelated set-level principal-value API.
